verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's own marketing says it charges for compute rather than wall time, and agents cost nothing when inactive. That points to usage-based pricing, not per-seat, but no evidence explicitly addresses seats, seat minimums, or how cost changes as a team grows. Missing for 10: an explicit pricing-page statement on per-seat vs. usage billing, any documentation on seat minimums or team-member charges, and independent corroboration that adding team members does not raise cost.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know whether pricing is per-seat with minimum seat counts that increase cost as my team grows

citations.quote: Cloudflare charges only for compute, not wall time, even during long agent workflows or hibernating WebSockets.
